before: Kana compression does not pull a kana and its spaced sound mark onto a full line, and PDF text gives a kana and a joined sound mark as the kana and the combining mark.
after: Kana compression pulls the pair onto the line as a line-start-prohibited mark, and PDF text gives a joined pair as the precomposed character.
reason: Only derived layout and PDF text change. Canonical OOXML, source offsets, operations, and collaboration formats remain unchanged.
